title: Model variant stewardship gateway and fast-path SLAs for enterprise onboarding
creator: Aisha Patel
description: Create a lightweight stewardship gateway that standardizes how enterprise model requests (new models, version pins, deprecated variants) enter the catalog. Goals: reduce time-to-acceptance for low-risk requests, enforce eval gates for high-risk requests, and expose clear SLAs for enterprise customers requesting pins or expedited onboarding.
background: We receive frequent enterprise requests for model variants, fast pins, and exception rollouts. Current intake is ad-hoc, causing inconsistent SLAs, manual risk assessments, and missed rollouts. Customers are asking for a predictable path for urgent pins and audited approvals for deprecated model migrations.
acceptance_criteria: Defined eligibility rules for fast-path onboarding (enterprise customers with contract tier and pre-approved steward)
A triage decision matrix that maps request attributes to one of: Fast-path, Standard review, Full eval gate
Documentation and public console messaging showing SLAs for each lane (e.g., Fast-path: 3 business days, Standard: 15 business days)
A minimal request form surfaced in the Console and via the PM intake API capturing risk signals and required artifacts
Audit trail created for each decision (request metadata, reviewers, timestamps, and attachments)
Automated routing to ENG/RESEARCH for any request that requires model binary changes or runtime kernel validation
implementation_steps: Draft triage matrix with Research and Infra (risk signals: PII, sequence length, quantization changes, kernel compatibility)
Create Console request form components and API endpoint for programmatic intake
Implement fast-path SLA timer and notification hooks in the intake service
Build eval-lite runner for shadow-evals and run on representative prompts for Standard lane
Add audit log fields to catalog metadata and wire to Console UI
Pilot with three enterprise partners and collect SLA metrics and qualitative feedback

decisions: Fast-path requires: enterprise contract tier, existing model stewardship relationship, and upfront preflight artifacts (prompt bank, fallback route)
Eval-lite will be mandatory for Standard lane but can be waived for Fast-path with steward sign-off
All pins older than 18 months require a deprecation plan and customer notification; set pin-expiry heuristic to 12 months for non-critical variants
SLA targets: Fast-path 3 business days, Standard 10 business days for triage decision, Full eval lane TBD (target 30 business days)
risks_and_mitigations: Risk: Fast-path abused by non-enterprise accounts — Mitigation: strict eligibility check and quota enforcement
Risk: Eval-lite misses distributional regressions — Mitigation: require a shadow run and a fallback rollback policy
Risk: Infra capacity strain for fast approvals — Mitigation: reserve small burst pool and instrument cost-alerting
